@graph.name: Hasibu
@graph.description: Offline-first enterprise attendance (PDKS), multi-branch biometric terminal sync, QR/GPS check-in, shift scheduling, leave management, and AES-256-GCM encrypted personnel dossier platform.

mainEntity.name: Hasibu nedir ve ne işe yarar?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hasibu; fabrikalar ve çok şubeli işletmeler için geliştirilmiş çevrimdışı öncelikli PDKS, yüz okutma terminali senkronizasyonu, QR/GPS yoklama, vardiya, izin ve SQLCipher/AES-256-GCM şifreli dijital özlük platformudur.

mainEntity.name: What is Hasibu and how does it protect privacy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hasibu is an offline-first enterprise attendance (PDKS) and HR platform that stores records locally in SQLCipher AES-256 and encrypts optional Google Drive backups client-side with AES-256-GCM under the restricted drive.file scope.
